statement: The splitting of the modular S3 extension after abelianizing its free kernel fails at integral class two; the obstruction is 1 in H²(S3,Z(sign))=Z/3, detected in an order-162 quotient. Relative pro-p section conjugacy classes number two at p=2, zero at p=3, and one at p>=5; rational class two has one conjugacy class with explicit central correction c^(-1/3).
manuscript_passages: §51.12; folios 700–704 and 715–716; scans 105–114 and 135–138, especially scan 136
notes: Exact identities (x rho)^3=[x,y] and ((x rho)sigma)^2=1. All 729 possible generator pairs in the finite order-162 quotient checked; zero sections. Nine sections in the order-54 abelian quotient and 81 lift pairs, every lifted order-three generator actually order nine. Quotient map P/F^(j) -> P/gamma_3F transfers non-splitting for j>=2, including third-derived. The marked-depth quotient is explicitly compared as a Lie quotient and its failure to retain the permutation swap is proved by a nonzero monomial. No new external theorem is used.
